# x402 UUID Toolkit

Deterministic UUID generate / validate / parse microservice for autonomous agents.

- POST /api/uuid  (paid via x402 exact USDC on Base)
- GET /catalog    (free discovery)

Actions: generate (v4|v7), validate, parse, toBytes, fromBytes.

Price guidance: ~0.004 USDC per call.

No human in the loop. Stateless. Edge-ready.
